    name = BCA_JR_SLOT_s8_RATE_script
    text = {
        trigger = {
            has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s8_mapped
            is_variable_set = bca_jr_slot_s8_automated_capacity_workforce
            check_variable = { which = bca_jr_slot_s8_automated_capacity_workforce value > 0 }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_JR_SLOT_s8_RATE_VALUE
    }
    default = BCA_JR_SLOT_RATE_EMPTY
}

    name = BCA_JR_SLOT_s15_RATE_script

        trigger = {
            has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_mapped

        }
        localization_key = BCA_JR_SLOT_s15_RATE_VALUE
    }
    default = BCA_JR_SLOT_RATE_EMPTY
}
